set.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Neuro core, formats, projection and display live in neurosurf4s over mesh4s and shared providers.
- Standalone GIFTI/FreeSurfer ingestion -> scalar display -> picking/readback works; existing CPU/native/browser conformance is retained with actual platform evidence.
- ScalaFIM atlas, spatial and connectivity consumers use public provider APIs; old surface/display implementations and duplicated fixtures are removed.

Close after its child implementation tasks and their evidence satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.
set.title: U5 milestone: Extract neurosurf4s and its display backends
